faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about creating and managing memorial pages

memorialDuration.question: How long will the memorial page remain active?
memorialDuration.answer: Your memorial page will remain active forever. We are committed to preserving these digital legacies indefinitely, ensuring that future generations can always remember and celebrate the lives of their loved ones.

contentTypes.question: What type of content can I add to a memorial page?
contentTypes.answer: You can add photos, videos, written memories, audio recordings, and important life milestones. Our platform supports various media formats to help you create a comprehensive and meaningful tribute.

privacyControl.question: Can I control who can view the memorial page?
privacyControl.answer: Yes, you have full control over the privacy settings. You can make the page public, private with password protection, or share it only with specific people via invitation links.

multipleContributors.question: Can multiple people contribute to the same memorial page?
multipleContributors.answer: Absolutely. You can invite family members and friends to contribute their own memories, photos, and stories. This creates a collaborative space where everyone can share their unique perspective and memories.

changesAfterCreation.question: Can I make changes to the memorial page after it's created?
changesAfterCreation.answer: Yes, you can update and edit the memorial page at any time. Add new content, modify existing information, or update privacy settings whenever needed.

cost.question: Is there a cost associated with creating a memorial page?
cost.answer: We offer both free and premium options. The free version includes essential features, while premium options provide additional storage, advanced customization, and enhanced privacy controls. Our goal is to make digital memorials accessible to everyone.

serviceDescription.content: Our memorial website service provides a platform to create and maintain online memorials for loved ones. This includes hosting, templates, and maintenance as specified in your chosen plan.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.content: You may request termination of service at any time. We reserve the right to terminate service for violation of terms. Memorial websites are maintained for the duration specified in your plan.

limitationOfLiability.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
limitationOfLiability.content: Our liability is limited to the amount paid for the service. We are not liable for indirect damages or losses resulting from service use.
